questions.stem: What are the three primary colours of light?
questions.explanation: The three primary colours of light are red, green, and blue (RGB). When combined in equal amounts, they produce white light. Cyan, magenta, and yellow are the secondary colours of light (and the primary colours for pigments/filters).

questions.stem: What happens when white light passes through a red filter?

options.text: Only red light passes through; other colours are absorbed
Red light is absorbed and other colours pass through

questions.explanation: A colour filter works by absorbing all colours of light except its own colour. A red filter transmits red light and absorbs all other colours (green, blue, etc.).
